title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Miller High Life Theatre, Milwaukee | 2025
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Miller High Life Theatre in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA, on 12 September 2025.

It was the 13th show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s 2025 tour. Starr had previously performed at the Miller High Life Theatre on 30 September 2023.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
